skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of culture, corporate culture, values, and the role of corporate culture.
Understand the relationship between culture and business strategy.
Identify cultural values, measure and evaluate corporate culture, and build and maintain corporate culture.
Recognize cultural obstacles and propose solutions to cultural conflicts.
Understand the role of leadership in building and developing corporate culture.
Apply knowledge to recognize cultural obstacles and propose solutions to cultural conflicts.
Recognize personal values and responsibilities in organizational development.
Develop and deliver presentations on corporate culture.
Work collaboratively in groups to analyze and present on corporate culture.
Understand the impact of culture on business operations and global business reputation.
